furka-grimsel-susten-big-three-dawn.title: Furka · Grimsel · Susten Big Three Dawn
furka-grimsel-susten-big-three-dawn.slogan: 3 passes in 223 km, topping out at 2429 m
furka-grimsel-susten-big-three-dawn.story: Three alpine legends, best before the traffic wakes up. 223 km round from Altdorf - plan on about 4 h 17 of riding. The climbs: Sustenpass west, Grimselpass reservoirs and Furkapass glacier road. It tops out at 2,429 m. Susten Pass, Grimsel Pass and Furka Pass are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. The passes are the reason to go.

waypoints.advice: You top out at 2224 m here. The road climbs 1766 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 11 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. At this height the road is a summer one: snow gates can stay shut into June and shut again in October. Next is Innertkirchen, mostly downhill.

sections.advice: Use Altdorf fuel gate → Sustenpass west ramp as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

This Sustenpass west ramp → Innertkirchen food reset stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2429 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
